degree_composition.boundary_homotopy: Uniform lateral-boundary nonvanishing preserves the lambda=0.22 boundary winding zero throughout 0.22<=lambda<=1.
degree_composition.imported_local_index: Every multiplicity-m real heat contact has local index +floor(m/2) in (x,t), hence -floor(m/2) in (t,x), including degenerate contacts.
degree_composition.nontriviality: For every lambda in [0.22,1], phi_n(u)>0 and all four coefficients are positive, so F_lambda(t,0)>0; the heat solution is nontrivial.
degree_composition.zero_degree_exclusion: Any contact would contribute a strictly negative integer to total degree. Since the degree is zero, the positive-time rectangle contains no contacts.

lambda_022_winding.convex_segment_homotopy: Each true lambda=0.22 segment image and its endpoint chord lie in the same convex interval rectangle, which excludes the origin by one component.
lambda_022_winding.orientation: positive boundary orientation in coordinate order (t,x): x=x_low upward in t, t=t_high rightward in x, x=x_high downward in t, t=t_low leftward in x

proof_boundary: This excludes contacts only for the finite homotopy H_1+H_2+H_3+lambda H_4 inside the declared positive-time rectangle and only for 0.22<=lambda<=1. It does not control contacts outside that rectangle, negative heat time, summands n>=5, the complete theta/Xi transform, an Xi collision, a degree-uniform Jensen remainder, Lambda<=0, RH, or a prize-level conclusion.
theorem: For every 0.22<=lambda<=1, (F_lambda,partial_x F_lambda) has no common zero in [0,0.45]x[135.5,136].
